risk_if_not_implemented: Without Jump Server, Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) may be unknown, untracked, lost, stolen or left unprotected because they are not inventoried. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), System / Data Compromise (Technical Vector) (R-BC-4), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Privileged Account Management (PAM)
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to restrict and control privileged access rights for users and Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS).
compensating_control_1.justification: Privileged Account Management (PAM) (IAC-10) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Jump Server (AST-34) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Session Audit
compensating_control_2.description:
Mechanisms exist to provide session audit capabilities that can: 
(1) Capture and log all content related to a user session; and
(2) Remotely view all content related to an established user session in real time.
compensating_control_2.justification: Session Audit (MON-18.1) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Jump Server (AST-34) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
